description:
Hi,

I hope you are doing good.

I have a job opportunity related to your profile with one of our client, please find below Job Description for your review. If you are interested and available for the following position then please send your updated resume in word format along with your contact details to discuss further.

 Note: Client is willing to Provide the Re-location Assistance. 

Role: Technology Analyst - Java/J2EE 
Duration: Full Time
Location: Hartford, CT

 Qualifications
Basic 
• Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent required from an accredited institution. Will also consider three years of progressive experience in the specialty in lieu of every year of education.
• At least 2 years of experience with Information Technologies.
 
 Preferred 
• At least 2 years of experience in Java/J2EE Technology and Frameworks.
• At least 2 years of working experience on different J2EE frameworks like Struts, Spring MVC, etc.
• At least 2 years of experience in development tools like Eclipse, WebSphere application server, etc.
• At least 2 years of experience in software development life cycle.
• At least 2 years of experience in translating functional/non-functional requirements to system requirements.
• Experience and understanding of in Production support and performance engineering.
• Ability to work in team environment and client interfacing skills.
• Analytical skills to identify root cause and come up with solutions/alternatives
• Experience and desire to work in a Global delivery environment


 • Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent required from an accredited institution. Will also consider three years of progressive experience in the specialty in lieu of every year of education.


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
